fields.description: Master kill switch. When disabled, all CRM Lead Dedupe features are skipped.
fields.label: Enable CRM Lead Dedupe

fields.description: Print compact CRM Lead Dedupe operation logs to server console.
fields.label: Enable Console Logs

fields.description: Show duplicate hit buttons, form actions, and duplicate modal.
fields.label: Enable UI

fields.description: Run duplicate detection hooks when CRM Leads are saved or updated.
fields.label: Enable Save Hooks

fields.description: Allow duplicate-group sync to archive/unarchive duplicate CRM Leads.
fields.label: Enable Auto Archive

fields.description: Allow duplicate records to be merged into a primary CRM Lead.
fields.label: Enable Merge

fields.description: Run the incremental auto-merge scheduler at the configured interval.
fields.label: Enable Scheduler

fields.description: Calculate and store duplicate hit counts on CRM Leads.
fields.label: Enable Hit Count

fields.description: Hide archived and converted CRM Leads from normal list/report queries.
fields.label: Enable Permission Filter

fields.description: When enabled, CRM Leads are treated as duplicates only when both mobile number and pipeline match.
fields.label: Match Duplicates By Pipeline

fields.description: When enabled, the newest active CRM Lead becomes the primary record during sync and merge, so repeat callers come up in recent lists.
fields.label: Use Newest Lead As Primary

fields.description: When enabled, the oldest eligible active CRM Lead becomes the primary record during sync and merge. The primary creation time is refreshed from the newest merged lead.
fields.label: Use Old Lead As Primary

fields.description: When set, only leads in these statuses are considered for duplicate sync and merge; other statuses remain independent.
fields.label: Statuses Eligible For Merge

fields.description: Maximum pending CRM Leads inspected by each scheduler run.
fields.label: Max Pending Leads Per Run

fields.description: Maximum distinct mobile groups processed by each scheduler run.
fields.label: Max Mobile Groups Per Run

fields.description: Maximum duplicate CRM Leads merged by each scheduler run.
fields.label: Max Merges Per Run

fields.description: Mobile groups larger than this are skipped to avoid unsafe bulk merges.
fields.label: Max Group Size

fields.description: Minimum minutes between auto-merge scheduler runs.
fields.label: Scheduler Interval Minutes

fields.description: One mobile key per line. These normalized mobile numbers are never auto-merged.
fields.label: Blocked Mobile Numbers
